item.title: 【Instrumentals / Karaoke (lossy)】MP3 - ITZY - Born To Be (Official Instrumental)
item.description:
Ripped from "BORN TO BE 2nd World Tour" Blu-ray menu! "Born to Be" Inst. is the menu music on one disc, and "UNTOUCHABLE" inst. is the menu music on the second disc. The cycling menu video containing the "UNTOUCHABLE" inst. is not a rippable file unfortunately, so I only have "Born To Be".

I also have the ripped instrumental menu music from the "CHECKMATE - 1st World Tour" Blu-ray Discs, and they contain "SHOOT!" and "DOMINO". Comment or DM me if anyone wants any of them and I'll get that posted when I can!
